title: STOPPED WORKING in 2 1/2 months and NO markings on water window
text: STOPPED WORKING in 2 1/2 months and NO markings on water window. I bought this coffeemaker December 23 and by March 9 it wasn't working.  I went to turn it on one morning and the on/off button would not push in. I had this coffeemaker before and it lasted about 2 years so I bought it again because I liked the simplicity of it.  When this one arrived it was the exact the same coffee maker except that for some reason it had no white markings (4-cup, 6-cups, etc.) on the water window. This was extremely annoying as I could not tell how much water to pour in but I chose to keep it anyway. When it turned out to be defective I was going to return it but Amazon has a measly 1 month return window. I figured I was out the money but called Amazon and was told I would be emailed a return address label. Unfortunately I was charged $5.00 for shipping. Needless to say I won't order another appliance from Amazon.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Manual Coffee Maker, White
features: Classic functionality and modest design keep brewing simple and easy for coffee drinkers that love the taste of a great cup of coffee
Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause stops cycle when you need a cup before brewing is finished
Dual Water Window to see exact water level as you fill, for no overflows
Power ON/OFF Indicator lights show coffee maker is in on mode and to remind you to shut it off
Lift & Clean Filter Basket for fast and easy clean up
Height:12.56 x Width:11.76 x Depth:8.43 Inches. Weight: 3.6 Pounds. Cord Length: 26 Inches, Watts: 900
description: The classic functionality of Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Manual Coffee Maker helps you make rich-tasting, expertly brewed coffee without stress or mess. Should you need a cup before the brew cycle is finished, Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause is a lifesaver. It stops brewing so you can pour freely, and then finishes the brewing cycle after you place the carafe back in position. It also features a removable basket filter that lifts out for quick and easy filling and cleaning. Whether you want a single cup or 12, this no-fuss automatic coffee maker will deliver the goods, time after time.
